1.5.3.17.rationale: Polyamine oxidase (N1-acetylspermine oxidase, PAOX) catalyzes a single FAD-dependent oxidation; no EuropePMC hits at all for a fused second catalytic activity.

1.7.3.3.rationale: Urate oxidase (uricase) is a single-activity oxidase; search returned 21 hits but none describe a second fused catalytic activity, only unrelated metagenomics/transcriptomics co-occurrences.

1.7.5.1.rationale: Nitrate reductase (quinone), e.g. the NarGHI respiratory complex, is a multi-subunit enzyme but performs one catalytic activity (nitrate to nitrite via quinol oxidation); no literature of a second fused catalytic activity surfaced.

2.1.1.115.rationale: (S)-coclaurine N-methyltransferase (benzylisoquinoline alkaloid biosynthesis) is a single SAM-dependent methyltransferase activity; zero EuropePMC hits for bifunctional/multifunctional/trifunctional co-occurrence.

2.3.1.133.rationale: Hydroxycinnamoyl-CoA:quinate transferase (HCT) is a single BAHD-family acyltransferase activity; the 27 search hits were unrelated (transcriptomics, proteomics, thiolase-deficiency papers), none describing a second catalytic activity.

2.3.1.176.rationale: This thiolase activity is carried by SCPx, a peroxisomal protein fusing a 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase domain with a C-terminal sterol carrier protein-2 (SCP2) domain; SCP2 is a non-catalytic lipid-binding/transfer domain, not a second catalytic (EC) activity, so this does not meet the bifunctional bar despite being a two-domain fusion protein.

2.3.1.57.rationale: Diamine/putrescine N-acetyltransferase (a GNAT-family acetyltransferase) carries a single acyl-transfer activity; no hits describing a fused second catalytic activity.

2.3.1.84.rationale: Alcohol O-acetyltransferase (phenylethanol acetyltransferase, e.g. yeast ATF1) is a single acyltransferase activity; search hits concerned unrelated wax-synthase/thioesterase reviews, none ascribing a second catalytic activity to this enzyme.

2.3.2.2.rationale: Gamma-glutamyltransferase (GGT) performs a single gamma-glutamyl transfer/hydrolase activity (including converting leukotriene C4 to D4); it is autoproteolytically processed into large/small subunits but this is not a second catalytic activity, and none of the 35 hits suggested one.

2.4.1.10.rationale: Fructan:fructan 1-fructosyltransferase (1-SST, GH32 family, plant inulin/levan biosynthesis) is a single glycosyltransferase activity; the 26 hits were about levan applications/production, not enzyme fusion.

2.4.1.111.rationale: UDP-glucose:coniferyl-alcohol glucosyltransferase (coniferin synthesis) is a single UGT-family glycosyltransferase activity; the 4 hits were unrelated lignin/transcriptome studies.

2.4.1.240.rationale: Flavonol-3-O-glucoside glucosyltransferase is a single UGT-family glycosyltransferase activity; zero EuropePMC hits for any fused second activity.

2.4.1.35.rationale: UDP-glucose:phenol beta-D-glucosyltransferase is a single glycosyltransferase activity; only 2 hits returned, neither relevant to a fused second activity.

2.4.1.91.rationale: UDP-glucose:flavonol 3-O-glucosyltransferase (UF3GT) is a single glycosyltransferase activity; the 3 hits were unrelated transcriptome papers.

2.4.2.4.rationale: Thymidine phosphorylase has a single phosphorolysis activity; its identity with platelet-derived endothelial cell growth factor (PD-ECGF) is a non-catalytic moonlighting/signaling role, explicitly excluded from bifunctional classification per the worked-example rule.

2.5.1.21.rationale: Squalene synthase catalyzes a two-step head-to-head condensation/NADPH reduction mechanism but this is classified and treated in the literature as one single catalytic (EC) activity, not two fused distinct enzyme activities; the 28 hits were unrelated plant/biosynthesis papers.

2.5.1.39.rationale: 4-hydroxybenzoate polyprenyltransferase (COQ2, ubiquinone biosynthesis) is a single prenyltransferase activity; only 3 hits returned, none relevant to enzyme fusion.

2.5.1.56.rationale: N-acetylneuraminate synthase (NeuB/sialic acid synthase) is a single PEP-condensing activity; a targeted search for fusion with CMP-Neu5Ac synthetase (NeuA) or other sialylation enzymes found no evidence of a fused second catalytic domain.

2.6.1.57.rationale: Aromatic-amino-acid (phenylalanine) aminotransferase is a single PLP-dependent transaminase activity; the 14 hits were unrelated microalgae/biofactory and transcriptome studies.

2.7.1.151.rationale: Inositol-polyphosphate multikinase family enzymes show broad substrate 'catalytic versatility' phosphorylating several inositol-phosphate positions, but this is substrate promiscuity within one kinase activity, not a second fused catalytic (EC) activity like the genuinely bifunctional PPIP5K kinase/phosphatase family.
2.7.1.151.evidence: PMID 14567754 (review of inositol phosphate kinase catalytic versatility, describing broad specificity rather than a second distinct catalytic domain)

2.7.1.162.rationale: GlcNAc-1-phosphotransferase is a multi-subunit complex (alpha2beta2gamma2, GNPTAB/GNPTG) with a single phosphotransferase activity; the downstream 'uncovering enzyme' (NAGPA) that removes the GlcNAc cap is a separate, unfused protein, confirming no second catalytic activity is fused into this enzyme.

2.7.1.23.rationale: NAD kinase (GTP-specific) is a single phosphotransferase activity; the 12 hits were unrelated NADPH-regeneration and metabolomics studies.

2.7.1.46.rationale: L-arabinokinase is a single phosphotransferase activity; only 1 unrelated hit returned.

2.7.4.24.rationale: Diphosphoinositol-pentakisphosphate kinase (PPIP5K/Vip1 family) is explicitly documented as a bifunctional enzyme fusing an N-terminal ATP-grasp kinase domain (synthesizing 1,5-InsP8 from 5-InsP7) with a C-terminal histidine-acid-phosphatase-like domain that hydrolyzes the same pyrophosphate bond back off, both being genuine catalytic activities in the same polypeptide.
2.7.4.24.evidence: PMID 31776069 ("A two-way switch for inositol pyrophosphate signaling: ... a unique, bifunctional kinase/phosphatase"); PMID 24152294

2.7.7.37.rationale: UTP:aldose-1-phosphate nucleotidyltransferase returned zero EuropePMC hits under any query form, with no indication in the literature of a fused second catalytic activity.
